---
title: "QrtShiny2"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
imiona <- read_csv("imiona.csv")
imiona
```

```{r}
wybrane_imiona <- c("Anna", "Piotr")

imiona %>% 
  filter(imie %in% wybrane_imiona, between(rok, 2005, 2015)) %>% 
  group_by(imie, rok) %>% 
  summarise(ile_razy = sum(liczba)) %>%  
  ggplot(aes(x = rok, y = ile_razy, color = imie)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2004:2016) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  theme_minimal()
```
